home.title: Welcome back, {{name}}.

locked.title: Daily challenges still locked
locked.text: The daily challenges start as soon as you have completed the onboarding in Basics.

actions.dailyMissionsText: Complete today's missions or catch up on available missions from recent days.

missions.title: Today's missions
missions.description: One mission at your current skill level awaits you every day. Missed missions stay available until Monday 12:00 noon of the following week.
missions.emptyText: Missions will appear here as soon as they are available.
missions.todayEmptyTitle: No missions are scheduled for today
missions.todayEmptyText: Missions will appear here as soon as they are published for today.
missions.availableEmptyText: Uncompleted missions appear here until Monday 12:00 noon of the following week.
missions.rankingInstruction: Sort the prompts from worst to best.

archive.filterText: Shows only past published missions you have already completed. Viewing them does not award points.
archive.emptyText: There are no past completed missions in this period.

result.partialSummary: {{correct}} of {{total}} statements are correct. You receive {{points}} points.

skillChange.title: Skill level adjusted
skillChange.demotion: Your current skill level is now {{level}}. Your next missions will be adjusted accordingly.

creator.manageDescription: Select a day in the monthly overview, inspect its scheduled mission, or edit every German and English content field.
creator.title: Create mission
creator.adaptiveHint: Define one shared topic and learning objective, then complete all three difficulty variants. Users automatically receive the variant for their skill level.
creator.rankingSolution: Correct order: worst to best prompt
creator.calendarText: The marker shows whether the daily mission slot is already occupied.
creator.noScheduled: No missions have been created for this date yet.
creator.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete the mission “{{title}}”?
creator.deleteBlocked: This mission has already been completed and can no longer be deleted.
creator.previewTitle: Mission preview in German and English

task.caseDataHint: German and English must contain the same number of semantically aligned rows or sections.
task.resultFieldsHint: These fields define which results learners enter and how they are scored automatically.

review.title: AI-generated missions for review
review.description: Review bilingual proposals before they are published as daily missions.
review.selectWeekDescription: Select a week through Monday to Friday in the calendar. Existing missions remain visible for each day.
review.researchFreshnessWarningTitle: Research may be older than the mission week
review.researchFreshnessWarning: This week is {{count}} weeks in the future. Mission generation uses the research pool available now, so developments published before that future week cannot yet be included.
review.rejectAllConfirm: Are you sure you want to reject all {{count}} review missions?
review.generatedFailed_one: {{count}} mission could not be generated successfully.
review.generatedFailed_other: {{count}} missions could not be generated successfully.
review.failureUnknown: No specific error reason was returned.

descriptions.preparing: The generation run is being prepared and handed over to n8n.
descriptions.running: AI is generating the missions and their difficulty variants.
descriptions.validating: Django is checking the structure, required fields, and domain constraints.
descriptions.reviewing: An independent AI reviewer is checking quality and consistency.
descriptions.repairing: Flagged content is being repaired and will then be validated again.

review.taskGenerated: A new AI hands-on task was created as a proposal.
review.empty: There are currently no AI-generated missions awaiting review.
review.rejectConfirm: Are you sure you want to reject the proposal “{{title}}”?

test.title: Mission debug area
test.description: Test every mission type with sample data without changing points or database records.

research.title: AI Finance Research
research.description: Manage the current research pool used to enrich selected weekly missions with recent AI developments.

run.title: Research agent
run.description: Scan the configured official sources and assess new AI developments for finance learning missions.

schedule.title: Automatic weekly research
schedule.description: The scheduler waits for this weekly time and calls n8n only when a research run is actually due.

library.title: Research library
library.description: Entries selected here are available to the mission generator until they expire or are deactivated.
library.emptyText: Start the research agent to fill the library with current, verified items.

edit.title: Edit research entry
edit.tagsHint: Comma-separated tags used by the context selector.
edit.factsHint: One fact per line: fact | supporting evidence
edit.hooksHint: One transferable learning idea per line.

delete.title: Delete research entry
delete.warning: The entry will immediately stop being available to future mission generations.

messages.started: The research agent has started. You can leave this page; its status will remain available.
messages.completed: Research completed. {{count}} new or updated entries were stored.
messages.scheduleSaved: The automatic research schedule was saved.

errors.load: The research library could not be loaded.
errors.run: The research agent could not be started or did not complete successfully.
errors.schedule: The research schedule could not be saved.
errors.update: The research entry could not be updated.
errors.delete: The research entry could not be deleted.

training.title: Practice games freely
training.description: Choose a game type and instantly generate a new exercise. Training does not affect points, leaderboard rank, or streaks.

result.wrong: That answer was not correct yet. Use the feedback for your next exercise.

singleChoice.title: Single choice
singleChoice.description: Practice a question with exactly one correct answer.

multipleChoice.title: Multiple choice
multipleChoice.description: Identify all applicable answers in a practical task.

complianceDecision.title: Compliance decision
complianceDecision.description: Practice safe decisions about AI usage in finance.

promptSelection.title: Prompt selection
promptSelection.description: Choose the clearest and most useful prompt for a situation.

promptRanking.title: Prompt ranking
promptRanking.description: Sort prompts from the weakest to the strongest instruction.

complianceTrafficLight.title: Compliance traffic light
complianceTrafficLight.description: Assess three scenarios as allowed, restricted, or prohibited.

aiChatChallenge.title: AI chat challenge
aiChatChallenge.description: Solve a finance case with no more than three focused questions to an embedded AI chat.

bulkCategorization.title: Bulk categorization
bulkCategorization.description: Use your AI assistant to assign many booking lines to categories and enter the totals per category.

planActualDeviation.title: Plan vs. actual deviation
planActualDeviation.description: Use your AI assistant to find cost centers that overran their budget and enter the key figures.

duplicatePaymentHunt.title: Duplicate payment hunt
duplicatePaymentHunt.description: Use your AI assistant to find accidental duplicate payments in a payment run.

invoiceExtraction.title: Invoice extraction
invoiceExtraction.description: Use your AI assistant to extract key figures from many invoice texts.

policyViolationCheck.title: Travel policy check
policyViolationCheck.description: Use your AI assistant to check expense lines against a given travel policy.

receivablesAging.title: Receivables aging
receivablesAging.description: Derive due dates from the payment terms and age the open receivables.

vatRateAudit.title: VAT rate audit
vatRateAudit.description: Use your AI assistant to find bookings where the wrong VAT rate was applied.

bankReconciliation.title: Bank reconciliation
bankReconciliation.description: Reconcile free-text payment references from the bank statement against the ledger.

chat.title: Mini chat
chat.empty: Ask focused questions, request an explanation of calculations, or test your assumption.

task.hint: Solve this task with your own tools (e.g. Excel) and your AI assistant such as Copilot. Copy the case data into it, then enter only the result values here.
task.promptHint: Stored for reference, but not part of the scoring.

agent.title: Your Agent
agent.description: Ask free-form questions about AI use, finance work, prompts, summaries, or safe next steps.
agent.emptyText: You can write like in a normal chat. Please do not enter confidential, personal, or Lufthansa-internal data.
agent.note: Send with Ctrl/⌘ + Enter. Please anonymize sensitive data.
starters: Help me write a prompt for a management summary.
How can I check an AI answer for hallucinations?
Make this statement more cautious for finance reporting.

userManagement.subtitle: Manage registered users, roles and access rights.

progressionSettings.title: Automatic skill progression
